brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball news thumbnail, landscape 16:9, target 1920 x 1080 or equivalent, width at least 1000 pixels. Opaque PNG. This is a new image.

Editorial content source: the provided frozen article is titled "11/27 試合結果・当日のEFF", game date 2026.11.27, covering multiple players equally in daily position-by-position EFF tables. Do not invent article claims.

Visual style: match the approved black-and-lime reference shown earlier: deep ink black #151A18 background, acid lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm ivory heavyweight Japanese sans-serif headlines, hand-painted ink hatching and dry-brush textures, very few elements, striking readable sports editorial design. Do NOT carry over the sample's player, name, date, scores or wording.

Subject: ONE real basketball player, Takeru Oba (大庭 岳輝). He was randomly chosen from the 14 unique players in the article tables, and is only an illustrative subject. Draw him recognizably from the official profile portrait just inspected, not a fictional generic athlete. Observed facial features: short dense black hair with uneven pointed fringe and a compact softly lifted top, close sides, straight substantial eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, straight nose, broad smooth oval face with gently squared jaw, closed medium-width lips, clean shaven, ears visible; athletic broad shoulders. Preserve this face as expressive hand-drawn ink illustration, not photography. His official portrait is appearance reference only: do not paste, trace, reproduce or collage the official photo itself.

Composition: energetic three-quarter view of Oba on the RIGHT half in a low forward driving stance, torso angled left, head turned enough toward the viewer for his face to stay recognizable. One hand naturally controls an orange basketball beside his bent hip as part of a dribbling action; the other forearm is raised slightly for balance with a relaxed open hand. Anatomically coherent arms, wrists and five-fingered hands. Frame head, both hands and ball fully inside the canvas, portrait from head to mid-thigh. Plain unbranded dark jersey with ivory brush highlights, no logo, sponsor, team name, number or badge. Sweeping diagonal lime brush motion behind him; abstract background only, no actual arena or identifiable game. This is a general imagined basketball action, not a reconstruction of a real game moment.

Typography: clear strong Japanese type, huge and legible. LEFT roughly 54% is uncluttered text area. Use only these exact text strings:
small top-left: "バスケまとめ"
date below: "2026.11.27"
very large primary headline: "試合結果"
second large line: "当日のEFF"
supporting line, smaller: "ポジション別TOP3"
bottom-left footer, readable with safe padding: "イラスト（AI生成）"
beside that footer: "イメージ"
All text must be accurate Japanese; main headline ivory and EFF can be lime. Keep 5% safe margin. Use no other writing, no player name, no statistics or claims about the pictured player, no score, no speech bubbles.

Constraints: hand-drawn editorial illustration only, NO photorealism, NO official photos embedded, NO team logos, NO league logos, NO sponsor marks, NO fictional players, NO additional people, NO card point totals, NO watermark. Do not depict or label the picture as an actual event. Preserve the exact AI disclosure text.

SINGLE REVISION
Edit the attached generated thumbnail, keeping exactly the same 1672 x 941 landscape canvas, ALL Japanese text and date unchanged, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B palette, ink/brush illustration style, overall left-text/right-player composition and AI label.
Make one targeted correction to the player: shrink the illustrated person and his ball together by about 8 percent and move slightly down and left within the right portion so his entire hair silhouette has a clear minimum 45-pixel margin below the top edge, and his bent outer elbow is entirely visible with a narrow margin from the right edge. The lower thighs may continue naturally out of the bottom. Do not shrink or move any lettering.
Preserve the identity of the real player Takeru Oba (大庭 岳輝), the face previously drawn and the official reference portrait. Make the black hair compact and softly tousled with a short uneven fringe, closer to the official portrait and less wildly spiky. Preserve the clean-shaven smooth oval face, gently squared jaw, almond eyes and straight nose. Preserve the coherent low dribbling pose and anatomically natural five-fingered hands with only normal occlusion by the ball. No added text, no logos, no jersey numbers, no photos, no additional people, no other design changes.
